notes.title: Demo Version 1.1 + new languages! 🎉
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who tried the demo so far, I've made a couple changes based on some of the feedback so far and updated the demo with loads of new additional languages!


Changes
Added a timer to the top of the screen to keep track of your progress/stress you out :) ⏱️

Fixed issues with some settings not saving properly

Made the demo a bit longer to give more of a taste of the full game

Improved the HUD ui to be a bit less cluttered and cleaner 🧹


New Languages 🌍
French

German

Spanish

Brazilian Portuguese

Japanese

Simplified Chinese



- Tom
